text:  Operating conditions (idle time, travel distance)  Battery efficiency Example Calculation - Assuming:  An electric forklift operates for 5 hours and consumes 2.5 kWh/hour.  Total weight lifted in this period is 10,000 kg. Total Energy Used=5×2.5=12.5 kWh Energy Consumption per kg=12.5/10,000=0.00125 kWh/kg Thus, the energy consumption is 0.00125 kWh/kg (or 1.25 Wh/kg). Taking into account the practical operation considerations and inefficiency and onboard power consumption, a fact 2 was used. Hence the energy consumption is 0.0025 kWh/kg. 42
